questionResults.question: What species has the longest wingspan
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `common name`, `scientific name`
FROM `Species`
ORDER BY `avg_Wingspan` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Wandering Albatross has the longest wingspan.

questionResults.question: What species in our database has the longest wingspan and what do they eat
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `common name`, `diet` 
FROM `Species` 
ORDER BY `avg_Wingspan` DESC 
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Bald Eagle has the longest wingspan in your database and primarily eats fish.

questionResults.question: What bird was seen last
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `b`.`Name`, `bs`.`Sighting date`
FROM `Bird` AS `b`
INNER JOIN `Bird Sighting` AS `bs` ON `b`.`id` = `bs`.`bird_id`
ORDER BY `bs`.`Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The last bird seen was Athena on August 22, 2026.

questionResults.question: what day of the week are more birds seen on
questionResults.sql:
SELECT strftime('%w', `Sighting date`) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS sightings
FROM `Bird Sighting`
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY sightings DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: More birds are seen on Saturdays.
